text:
zoe (partnerships): Heads-up — scheduling a vendor sync tomorrow 10:00am PT (partners + eng + platform + marketing). Topic: HW roadmap + thermal/power variance across H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi and impact on marketplace routing + joint announcement windows. Need decisions on fallback routing, power-profile tagging, and embargo contingency. @matt @raj @ana

matt (eng-infra): On it. Eng-runtime + infra will join. Quick Q — do we have p95 thermal-trigger thresholds per SKU right now?

raj (hw-ops): We do — short lab summary inline: H100 stable across 24h, H200 shows ~15-25W thermal creep after ~8h sustained peak, B200 shows ~20-30W on our rack configs under perf tests. MI300 GA numbers look good but vendor PSU wiring variance affects headroom. I'll upload the CSV to the drive: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folder/sku-thermal-2026 (internal).

ana (marketing): (typo) ana (marketing): Marketing note — if announce windows shift we need 72h heads-up for partner comms. Also embargo coordination across cloud marketplaces is non-trivial; prefer to avoid mid-embargo SKU swaps.

liam (platform): Platform suggestion: tag images/AMIs/containers with metadata like "power-profile: high | standard | low" and expose a routing policy that prefers standard but can pick low when thermal headroom < threshold. Example policy snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  prefer: standard
  fallback_order: [low]
  thermal_threshold_watts: 150
  dedicated_handling: require_opt_in
```

raj (hw-ops): YAML looks ok. Two caveats: 1) 'low' profile on B200 typically drops throughput ~12% vs standard (ran benchmark). 2) telemetry latency matters — thermal-trigger window needs hysteresis to avoid flapping (recommend 30s aggregate).

matt (eng-infra): Engineering notes: we can implement fallback routing in the gateway proxy and gate with a rollout flag. Suggest canary region first, then global. We also need KV-cache affinity considerations so cached prefixes don't get thrashing when routes change.

zoe (partnerships): Action items I captured: 1) raj upload full lab CSV + 1-page TL;DR (thermal, power, perf delta) — due EOD. 2) matt scope routing change + canary plan + KV-cache impact — sync by EOD tomorrow. 3) liam prototype image tagging + sample routing policy + test harness. 4) ana draft external comm contingency & embargo language w/ legal. Meeting invite sent. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Invite created — "vendor-hw-roadmap-sync" — 2026-03-24 10:00 PT — attendees: partnerships, eng-runtime, platform, hw-ops, marketing.

matt (eng-infra): One more Q — Dedicated reservations: do we treat them as non-evictable? If so, fallback routing shouldn't auto-evict; we need opt-in behavior.

raj (hw-ops): Agreed. For Dedicated customers, propose an "allow-fallback" deploy flag. If false, routing will route to compatible SKU variants only (or failover regions).

ana (marketing): ana (marketing): Noted — will include "allow-fallback" opt-in in external comms. Legal loop required for T&Cs.

zoe (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll add a short draft to the runbook: /docs/runbooks/hw-fallbacks (draft) and link the invite + artifacts. See you tomorrow.

liam (platform): :eyes: adding prototype branch now, will ping when PR is up.

raj (hw-ops): Upload done — file: sku_thermal_summary_2026-03-23.csv (drive link above).

matt (eng-infra): I'll put a preliminary canary plan into the eng ticket and add load profiles.

zoe (partnerships): Closing thread for now — comment if anything else. Thanks! :rocket:
